pmm.caveat: Sampled PMM allocated frames, includes kernel/other residents; not exact peak or per-process RSS; includes reserved kernel heap backing pages; heap live bytes are not a separate physical allocation.
pmm.history_scope: PMM allocation low-water in existing512x10ms ring after initial partial baseline tick, excluding boot OOM. Poll gaps>512ticks invalidate complete peak coverage. PMM includes heap backing pages; cumulative heap high-water is reported separately, never added to physical RAM. Includes kernel/other residents, not per-process RSS or whole boot peak.

inode_after.scope: Bounded inode metadata/capacity only, names hashed; no file contents, raw heap, cookies or keys; does not assign non-file heap allocations.
